//3: Every key is optional: with no config at all the skill uses its built-in presets
//4: (claude, codex, omp, gemini, opencode, droid, copilot, cursor) and launches claude.
//5: herdr talks to a local socket, so no credential is ever needed here.
//agents: Launchable subagents. A name matching a built-in overrides it key by key; any other name is yours alone. Only `command` is required.

agents.//claude: Overriding a built-in: same agent, extra argv. Arrays replace wholesale across layers.

claude.//markers: How replies are scraped: replyMarker prefixes the agent's own output, composerMarker its input line, chrome lists per-line furniture regexes (spinners, hint rows, status bar).

agents.//reviewer: A preset is a role, not just a binary - argv, cwd, env and timeouts together.
agents.//scratch: cwd keeps an agent out of a project, so it inherits no CLAUDE.md, hooks or SessionStart work.

scratch.description: inert agent in a scratch directory

agents.//codex: Non-Claude agents work the same way, with their own markers - Codex prefixes output with • and its composer with ›.
agents.//farm: session sends the agent to a different herdr server, keeping long jobs out of your working session.

//defaults: Applied to every preset that does not set the key itself. Shown values are the built-in defaults.
